periods.time: During the banquet, after Tatara's disturbance

name.zh: 黑乃质问月影真正目的

periods.summary: Kurono confronts her former teacher Tsukikage over Akatsuki's attack and deduces that his goal is not simply reclaiming Blazer education but forcing Japan to break completely from the International Mage-Knight League.
periods.cause: Kurono sees Akatsuki's illegal methods as too extreme for ordinary education-policy reform.
periods.process: Tsukikage first repeats the public rationale, then admits that illegal means are useful because only illegality can break an unjust law. Kurono reasons that he deliberately made negotiation impossible by involving Rebellion-linked fighters.
periods.outcome: Tsukikage confirms that he wants Japan to sever League ties. Kurono resolves not to burden her students with the political scheme and trusts Hagun's representatives to defeat Akatsuki on the tournament stage.
periods.significance: Reveals the hidden national stakes behind Akatsuki Academy and the tournament.
